Looking at this question about the katE mutant strain of Acinetobacter baumannii and its sensitivity to desiccation compared to wild-type.

The katE gene encodes a catalase enzyme that protects bacteria from oxidative stress. Studies on A. baumannii have examined the desiccation sensitivity of katE knockout strains compared to wild-type.

Based on research findings regarding katE mutants in A. baumannii, the desiccation sensitivity of the mutant is approximately 5-fold greater than that of the wild-type strain.

[ANSWER]C[/ANSWER]
